verses.text: Ayik toxo ix cham winhaj rey Acab, ix yik'anel sb'a chonhab' Moab t'a yalanh smandar chonhab' Israel.

Ay jun k'u ix kot sutnaj winhaj Ocozías yuninal winhaj Acab chi' t'a spanhanil yib'anh spat t'a Samaria. Te niwan ix aj winh slajwi, yuj chi' ix schekb'at heb' schekab' winh yik b'at sk'anb'ej yab' heb' t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal heb' aj Ecrón, tato olto b'oxok winh.

Palta a jun yángel Jehová ix halan t'a winhaj Elías aj Tisbe icha tik: Ixik, b'at cha heb' schekab' winhaj Ocozías sreyal Samaria, tzalan t'a heb' icha tik: ¿Tom malaj Dios t'a ko chonhab' a onh israel onh tik, yuj chi' hato t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal Ecrón sb'at he k'anb'ej eyab'i? xa chi t'a heb'.

Tzalanpaxi to a in Jehová in swal t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Manhxo ol ach k'e waan, palta ol ach chamxonhej, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi yángel Jehová chi' t'a winhaj Elías chi'. Ix b'at winhaj Elías chi', ix sk'anab'ajan winh icha tas ix alji chi' t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj heb' schekab' winh rey chi', ix k'ochxi heb' t'a yichanh winh, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb': --¿Tas yuj ix ex meltzaj t'a elanhchamel? xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix tak'wi heb': --Mamin rey, ay jun winh winak ix ko cha t'a yol b'e. Ha winh ix halan t'ayonh icha tik: Meltzajanhek t'a winh ix ex chekankot chi', tzeyalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: ¿Tom malaj Dios t'a Israel tik, yuj chi' hato t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal Ecrón tza chekb'at ab'chajok? Yuj wal jun tas ix a na' tik, manhxo ol ach k'e waan, ol ach chamxonhej, xchi Jehová, xe chi, xchi jun winh chi' t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --¿Chajtil yilji jun winh ix halan chi' t'ayex? xchi winh.
--Mamin rey, a jun winh chi' ayoch jun pichul ay xiil yuj winh, aypaxoch jun tzek'ul tz'uum t'a snanhal winh, xchi heb' t'a winh. --Ha jun winh chi', haton winhaj Elías aj Tisbe, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekanb'at jun winh kapitán winh rey chi' yet' 50 heb' winh soldado yik b'at ik'jokkot winhaj Elías chi'. Haxo yik ix k'och heb' t'a winh, k'ojanem winh t'a jun tzalan. Ix yalan winh kapitán chi' t'a winh: --Ach schekab' Dios, a winh rey ix alankoti to tzach emta, xchi winh kapitán chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Tato schekab' in Dios, kotokab' k'ak' t'a satcha'anh tzach tz'ab'at yet' 50 heb' winh a soldado chi', xchi winh. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix emta k'ak', ix tz'ab'at heb' winh smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekanxib'at junxo winh kapitán winh rey chi' yet' 50-xo heb' winh soldado, ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Elías chi': --Ach schekab' Dios, emanhkot t'a elanhchamel yal winh rey, xchi winh kapitán chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Elías chi': --Tato schekab' in Dios, kotokab' k'ak' t'a satcha'anh tzach tz'ab'at yet' 50 heb' winh a soldado chi', xchi winh. T'a wal jun rato chi' ix emta k'ak' t'a satcha'anh, ix tz'ab'at heb' winh smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekanxib'at junxo winh kapitán winh rey chi' yet' 50-xo heb' winh soldado t'a yoxelal. Palta a jun winh kapitán chi', ix k'ek'och winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Elías chi', ix em kuman winh t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan winh: --Mamin schekab' Dios, ak' wal niwank'olal t'a wib'anh yet' 50 heb' winh soldado a chekab' tik.

Yujto a juntzanh heb' winh kapitán yet' soldado, heb' winh ix b'ab'laj ja t'ayach, ix tz'ab'at heb' winh yuj k'ak' ix kot t'a satcha'anh. Ha in tik tzin tewi t'ayach to tzonh ak' niwank'olal yik max onh chami, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan yángel Jehová chi' t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Ixik yet' winh, manh ach xiwok, xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix emta winhaj Elías chi', ix b'at winh yet' winh kapitán chi', ix b'at winh yil winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winh rey chi': --Icha wal tik yalan Jehová: Yujto ix a chekb'at heb' a chekab' t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal Ecrón, yik b'at a k'anb'ej a b'a, ichato malaj Dios t'a Israel tik b'aj syal tza k'anb'ej ab'i, yuj chi' manhxo ol ach k'e waan, palta to ol ach chamxonhej, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Elías chi'.

Icha chi' ix aji, ix cham winh rey chi', icha tas ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Elías chi'. Yujto malaj junok yuninal winhaj Ocozías chi', yuj chi' a jun winh yuk'tak winh skuchan Joram, a winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok, haton yik schab'ilxo ab'il yoch junxo winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Josafat reyal t'a Judá.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Ocozías yet' juntzanhxo tas ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
